a: not listed (team seed awards to fellows)
dt: Fellow applications due Apr 15, 2027 for full consideration; first meeting Nov 3–6, 2027 (Tucson, AZ)
e: New Scialog initiative (2027–2029) that invites about 50 early-career faculty, from first year on faculty through recently post-tenure, to a meeting where teams form and compete for seed funding on modeling and characterizing the atmospheres of Earth, solar-system planets and exoplanets. It seeks exoplanet observers, astrophysicists, planetary and atmospheric scientists, astrostatisticians and laboratory chemists; applicants apply through the RCSA portal.
n: Scialog: Terrestrial and Extraterrestrial Atmospheres (2027 Fellows)
unv: Co-sponsors, seed award amounts and any country limit are not stated on the initiative page (RCSA generally funds US and Canadian institutions).
